messages:
maya: FYI running into a weird edge case in CI — localized links with spaces are getting percent-encoded and Docusaurus serves the non-encoded path, so the link checker reports 404s.

sam: ah yeah, seen that before with generated TOCs. Do you have an example?

maya: example from CI output: 
```
http://docs.redwood.ai/docs/en/guide/getting%20started#installation -> 404
expected: /docs/en/guide/getting-started#installation
```

kevin: that looks like our slugify/anchor normalization mismatch between the markdown processor and the link generator. Could be the locale prefix codepath that appends raw titles.

maya: I dug into the build log: 
`docs-build › docusaurus › linkcheck` shows: 
`WARN Broken link: /docs/en/guide/getting%20started#installation (found in /docs/en/intro.md)`

olivia: is this only for space -> %20 or also other chars (like parentheses, unicode)?

maya: spaces and `:` in some titles. Also saw non-ascii (em dash) become different anchors in en vs fr builds.

sam: quick fix idea — normalize the source links during markdown rendering to use slugified file names (kebab-case) and ensure linkcheck uses the same resolver. Longer fix is to align the anchor generator used for the TOC and the permalinks.

kevin: I can put up a patch that updates the slugify util under `docs/utils/slugify.js` and adds a unit test for `%20` -> `-` conversion. Will also add a CI step that runs linkcheck on both `en` and `fr` build outputs.

maya: thanks. can you open a draft PR and tag docs-review? If possible also backport to `v1.2` (we still have customers on that docs tag).

kevin: opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2115 (draft). Added description + failing CI screenshot.

docs-bot: PR opened by kevin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2115 — labels: docs, needs-review, backport-candidate

olivia: i'll review tomorrow morning. quick question: will this change affect existing inbound links (we don't want to break older bookmarks).

kevin: good point — the plan is to add a redirect rule in `static/_redirects` for the percent-encoded paths to the slugified ones, so old links continue to work. I'll include that in the PR.

sam: also add a small release note in CHANGELOG.md under docs so customers know about improved link handling + redirects.

maya: QA request: after merge can someone run `yarn build && npx docusaurus linkcheck` locally for `en` and `fr` and paste the output here? I'll mark the issue resolved once CI and local pass.

kevin: will do. pushing updated patch with redirect file and tests now. :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks all — sounds good. If tests are flaky, tag me and i'll help with the CI flakiness triage.

maya: closing loop: PR merged, backport cherry-pick created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2120. CI passed on both locales, local linkcheck clean. Closing thread. :tada:
